scope: W1 local owner source review for normalization, transactional input buckets and retained views; not all B09
method: Derive ordered source contracts before comparison to active RAW and Live documentation. Join exact historical row/node crosswalk and CP292 recovered site metadata to line-specific contract IDs. Rows sharing a contract preserve individual operation, span and scope; no full current canonical replay. Access/effect/exit coverage tracked separately from W1 four-category denominator.

groups.title: Optional tails
groups.meaning: Lower and main accumulators start from supplied tail references or null; list is empty only on null, otherwise singleton containing same dictionary. Even lower-only mode retains supplied main tail.

groups.title: Row and price normalization
groups.meaning: Iterate supplied order; convert time with native int; invoke decimal callback for open, high, low, close in that order. Access required keys directly; missing keys and conversion exceptions propagate; no sort or OHLC validation.

groups.title: New lower bucket
groups.meaning: Short-circuit null current or unequal exact integer timestamp selects allocation; store first open/high/low/close and append dictionary; no global duplicate merge.

groups.title: Existing lower bucket
groups.meaning: Mutate same lower dict: max(previous high,new high), min(previous low,new low), replace close; retain open and time. Equal extrema retain first operand representation; no quantization.

groups.title: Lower-only and aligned key
groups.meaning: Truthy lower_only skips entire main branch for this row; otherwise timeframe==1 selects raw epoch, else integer floor quotient times timeframe; no positivity guard in this helper.

groups.title: New main bucket
groups.meaning: Null current or key inequality selects new main dict with original row prices; append. Same-key consecutive aggregation only.

groups.title: Existing main and return
groups.meaning: Update high/low/close in order with previous first, retain original open/time; return pair of lower/main lists including any supplied tails.

groups.title: Batch cache ownership
groups.meaning: Bind native as_decimal and allocate local typed-value dictionary per call; no persistent price state.

groups.title: Cache lookup
groups.meaning: Key is ordered pair exact runtime type and value; lookup catches only KeyError. On miss native as_decimal returns existing Decimal (including subclass) or Decimal(str(value)); store/return; equal typed numeric values reuse first representation including exponent. Unhashable input or normalization/insertion failures propagate.

groups.title: Delegation and delta schema
groups.meaning: Delegate rows/timeframe/callback/lower_only unchanged. BucketAppend frozen slotted metadata, four integer annotations (not runtime validation). Dirty positions and settled counts separate.

groups.title: Live constructor
groups.meaning: Exact type int required before positive guard timeframe>=1; excludes bool/subclass. Set timeframe, empty lower, same list at TF1 otherwise separate list, last timestamp null, persistent cache empty.

groups.title: Append context
groups.meaning: Enter stage_append, return yielded delta only after normal context exit; context exceptions propagate.

groups.title: Empty stage
groups.meaning: Capture current lengths as dirty indexes; falsy rows yield delta and return, no state mutation; no rollback block around this yield because no published changes.

groups.title: Tail selection
groups.meaning: Convert first timestamp before iterator validation; align first key by floor division. Copy previous lower tail only with nonempty lower and equal last raw time; rewind dirty lower by one. Main tail copy/rewind only nonshared, nonempty main and same aligned key. Short-circuit guard order retained.

groups.title: Shared main and staged state
groups.meaning: At TF1 dirty main=dirty lower; capture prior time and allocate private new-price dictionary.

groups.title: Checked iterator
groups.meaning: For each row int-convert time; reject numeric inequality to original or <=0, then reject strictly decreasing relative to prior if non-null. Equality allowed; bool/numeric integer-equivalent may pass because no exact-type check here. Update captured time then yield original mapping.

groups.title: Live typed price cache
groups.meaning: Persistent typed-value membership first, return existing; else check private additions, normalize/store only if missing, return private result. No update to persistent cache yet.

groups.title: Staged aggregation
groups.meaning: Aggregate lazy checked rows, persistent-or-local normalization, copied tails and shared-main lower_only. Failure before commit leaves original suffixes and persistent cache untouched (native pure normalization assumed).

groups.title: Commit sequence before protection
groups.meaning: Snapshot old lower suffix, nonshared old main suffix or empty list, old timestamp. Add price keys, slice-assign lower list, nonshared main list, update last time in order. No catch covers these commit assignments; list identities retained.

groups.title: Protected yield rollback
groups.meaning: Try includes delta construction and consumer body; catch BaseException, restore lower and nonshared main suffixes, restore last time, delete each newly inserted price key, rethrow. No arbitrary external side-effect rollback; cleanup error can supersede original.

groups.title: Dirty and settled metadata
groups.meaning: Return dirty values as supplied, settled lower/main=max(0,length-1) independently; exclusive counts; latest bucket mutable until later key. No inferred completion across gaps.

groups.title: Candle materialization order
groups.meaning: New list; bind append, engine.Candle/classifier, local timestamp converter and format. Enumerate supplied bucket order from start_index. Timestamp uses Tehran naive local time; missing fields/constructor callbacks propagate.

groups.title: Candle fields and native color
groups.meaning: Constructor receives enumerated index, naive timestamp, formatted six date components, native tag classification with original open and close, and unchanged OHLC objects. Native Candle frozen/slotted; open<=close is GREEN including equality, else RED. Configured replacement conditional. No OHLC rounding.

groups.title: Live views identity
groups.meaning: New lists, null lower/main indexes; allocate fresh independent LiveClosedRegimes map per view instance. No shared global closed-cache.

groups.title: Suffix replacement
groups.meaning: If index present use first_dirty as given, otherwise zero. Construct candles for bucket suffix using same start index and replace list suffix before index action; no local rollback. Prefix object references retained.

groups.title: Index capacity/refresh
groups.meaning: If absent or len(candles)>index.size create fresh native index with retain_crossings true; equal capacity reuses. Otherwise invoke refresh_suffix(first), which requires 0<=first<=old_length<=new_length<=capacity, no shrinking, first==new_length no-op; clears crossing history only if first<old_length-1, replaces times/leaves/ancestors. Newly built index has empty history; failures can occur after list mutation.

groups.title: Lower update first
groups.meaning: Timed lower update receives exact retained lower list/index and lower dirty delta; assignment only after timed return. Timer/callback exceptions propagate; lower list may already be changed.

groups.title: Main alias or update
groups.meaning: TF1 aliases both main list and index to lower; else timed independent main update with main dirty index. Lower update first, no local rollback; outer protected Live wrapper discards entire views on BaseException.
